title: Establishment of a Long-Term Co-culture Assay for Mesenchymal Stromal Cells and Hematopoietic Stem/Progenitors
protocol: Purchase parental OP9 cells from ATCC.
Maintain the purchased cells in DMEM media with supplements as mentioned below.
Remove culture media carefully without disrupting the cellular layer.
Wash the cellular layer with 1× PBS.
Trypsinize the cells using 500 μL of 0.05% Trypsin containing 0.05% EDTA for 2–3 min at 37°C.
Observe the flask under microscope to check that the cells have detached.
Gently tap the flask if there are still attached cells in the flask.
Add equal volume of OP9 culture media after trypsinization for neutralization.
Collect the cell suspension in fresh 15 mL tubes.
Pellet down the cells at 125 × g for 5 min at 25°C–30°C.
Resuspend cells in 5 mL of fresh culture media.
Count viable cells using trypan blue and hemocytometer.
Mix 10 μL of trypan blue with 10 μL of media containing cells in suspension.
Mix carefully and add 10 μL of the mixture to a hemocytometer for counting trypan blue negative (live) cells using an inverted microscope.
Pre-coat TC 96-wells by adding 100 μL of 0.01% poly-L-lysine for 2 hours at 25°C–30°C.
Remove poly-L-lysine completely from the wells.
Ensure the wells are dry before seeding the cells.
Count the number of viable OP9 cells.
Seed OP9 cells at a density of 2.5 × 10−3/cm² per well in 200 μL of DMEM supplemented with 20% FBS, Pen-Strep (1×), and L-glutamine (1×) per well.
Use the inner 60 wells for seeding cells in a 96-well plate.
Add sterile water or PBS to the unused peripheral 36 wells to maintain humidity.
Perform a half media change after 3 days when the media color partially changes to yellow and cells are 50% confluent.
Replace culture media one day after irradiation with IMDM media containing hydrocortisone and 20% horse serum.
Use Mitomycin C to inhibit excessive growth of the adherent cell layer for long-term culture assays.
Isolate HSPCs once the adherent layer is ready around day 6.
Collect cord blood samples from term pregnancies after obtaining informed consent.
Perform density gradient centrifugation with 25 mL of undiluted cord blood layered on top of 25 mL of Lymphoprep or Ficoll (1.077 g/mL).
Isolate mononuclear cells from the interface layer following centrifugation.
Enrich HSPCs one day prior to seeding for co-culture by pre-stimulating with recombinant SCF, FLT3L, and TPO at 10 ng/mL each for 12–16 hours.
Evenly distribute 50 mL of cord blood sample into two 50 mL centrifugation tubes.
Perform density gradient centrifugation at 400 × g using a horizontal rotor, for 30 minutes at 25°C to 30°C, with acceleration set at 9 and deceleration at 0.
Repeat the density gradient centrifugation once more for a total of two times.
Collect the mononuclear cells that form a white ring between the Lymphoprep layer and plasma using a serological pipette without disturbing the gradient.
Wash the mononuclear cells with 40 mL of PBS at 500 × g for 5 minutes at 25°C to 30°C.
Mix 10 μL of trypan blue with 10 μL of PBS containing cells in suspension in a separate microcentrifuge tube.
Add 10 μL of the mix to hemocytometer for cell counting using an inverted microscope.
Take viable cell counts based on trypan blue exclusion.
Proceed with isolation of CD34+ cells or immediately freeze the mononuclear cells.
Resuspend cell pellets in 100% FBS, adjusting total resuspension volume based on the number of vials needed for freezing and the total number of mononuclear cells obtained from the sample.
Add 500 μL of cell suspension to each 1.8 mL cryogenic vial.
On top of the cell suspension in each vial, add 500 μL of freezing solution containing 20% DMSO and mix gently.
Store the cryogenic vials placed within a freezing container at -80°C immediately after mixing.
Transfer the vials into liquid nitrogen containers for long-term storage within 24-48 hours.
Thaw cryopreserved specimens in sufficient complete media.
Rapidly add the sample to complete media and gently tap the container at 25°C–30°C.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 1,000 × g for 5 minutes at 25°C–30°C.
Aspirate out the media containing DMSO.
Wash twice with 50 mL of PBS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL PBS.
Pass the cell suspension through a 70 μm filter to remove clumps.
Take viable cell count before proceeding for immunomagnetic selection.
Remove RBC contamination by performing RBC lysis after first density gradient centrifugation.
Resuspend mononuclear cells in 25 mL of 1× RBC lysis buffer and incubate at 25°C–30°C for 5 minutes.
Top up the tube with sufficient volume of PBS after incubation.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g for 10 minutes at 25°C–30°C.
Wash cells with PBS to remove residual RBC lysis buffer.
Take viable cell counts.
Cryopreserve mononuclear cells or proceed immediately for CD34+ cell isolation.
Performing two consecutive rounds of density gradient centrifugation.
Filter the prepared solutions and store at 4°C for up to 6 months, warming before use.
Resuspend mononuclear cells in 500 μL of EasySepTM buffer or recommended media (PBS containing 2% FBS and 1 mM EDTA).
Isolate CD34+ cells using Column-free human CD34 progenitor isolation kit.
Add CD34+ selection cocktail from the kit to the cell suspension at a concentration of 100 μL/mL.
Mix and incubate at 25°C–30°C for 15 min.
Thoroughly mix magnetic particles by pipetting up and down at least five times.
Add magnetic particles at a concentration of 50 μL/mL to the sample.
Incubate at 25°C–30°C for 10 min.
Add EasySepTM buffer or recommended media to the tube up to 2.5 mL and mix thoroughly 2-3 times.
Place the tube in the magnet and incubate for 5 min.
Invert the magnet and tube together to discard supernatant without shaking off drops adhered to the side walls of the tube.
Leave the tube inverted for an additional 2–3 s before proceeding.
Repeat steps (h) to (j) for a total of five times.
Remove the tube from the magnet.
Top up with 4 mL of recommended media and centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at 25°C–30°C, keeping acceleration 9 and deceleration 0.
Resuspend the cell pellet in IMDM media supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 mg/mL streptomycin, and 2 mM L-glutamine.

Pre-stimulate cells for 12–16 hours with 10 ng/mL of each recombinant human SCF, FLT3L, and TPO in IMDM complete media (supplemented with 10% FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 mg/mL streptomycin, and 2 mM L-glutamine).
Take viable cell counts immediately after immunomagnetic separation.
Take viable cell counts after overnight pre-stimulation.
Ensure that the adherent cell layer is 100% confluent.

Seed 25 × 10^3 CD34+ cells per well over the stromal monolayer in 200 μL of IMDM supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated FBS, β-mercaptoethanol, 5% horse serum, 10−5 M hydrocortisone, 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 mg/mL streptomycin, and 2 mM L-glutamine.
Co-culture at 37°C in the presence of 5% CO2 for 5 weeks.
Add PBS or sterile water to peripheral wells to prevent media evaporation and maintain humidity.
Check plate every three days under a microscope to ensure cells appear healthy and sufficient media volume is present.
Replenish one-half of the co-culture media (100 μL) every week without disturbing the adherent feeder layer and HSPCs.
Collect media from wells in microfuge tubes.
Spin down at 500 × g for 5 min at 25°C–30°C to avoid loss of HSPCs during media change.
Resuspend collected cells in 100 μL of fresh co-culture media and gently add back to the wells, maintaining a total volume of 200 μL per well.
Harvest cells for clonogenic assay by removing media from wells and transferring it to fresh microfuge tubes.
Rinse each well with PBS.
Add this PBS to tubes containing media previously removed from the wells.
Trypsinize the wells with 100 μL of 0.05% trypsin containing 0.05% EDTA per well for 3–5 minutes at 37°C.
Check the wells under a microscope to ensure that the adherent layer has started to detach from the surface.
Stop trypsinization by adding 100 μL of IMDM supplemented with 20% heat-inactivated FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 mg/mL streptomycin, and 2 mM L-glutamine.
Collect the cell suspension in tubes which already contain media and PBS collected from the wells prior to trypsinization.
Spin down at 500 × g for 7–10 minutes at 25°C–30°C.
Remove the media.
Wash with PBS and spin at 500 × g for 7–10 minutes at 25°C–30°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μL of basal IMDM media.
Thaw MethoCult and aliquot 3 mL into 14 mL round-bottom tubes.
Add 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 mg/mL streptomycin, and 2 mM L-glutamine to each tube containing 3 mL of MethoCult.
Add the entire single cell suspension from each well to the tube containing 3 mL of Methocult using cut tips.
Vortex the tube thoroughly.
Allow the tube to stand for 5 min.
Aliquot the MethoCult containing the cells into a 35 mm gridded tissue culture scoring dish using a 5 mL syringe fitted with an 18-gauge blunt-end needle.
Ensure minimum bubble formation by slowly adding MethoCult to the gridded dish.
Evenly spread the MethoCult across the dish.
Place the plates in a 150 mm dish along with a 35 mm dish containing sterile water.
Incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 with ≥ 95% humidity for 14–16 days.
Score the number and type of colonies at the end of the incubation period.
Count the well as positive if one or more CFU-G/GM, CFU-GEMM, or BFU-E colonies are present.
Score the well as negative if no colonies are present.
